failed_step: Resume the same execution after explicit worker handoff
evidence: GitHub CLI failed with: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
cause: The handoff workflow checks out protected and run repositories into control/ and run/, but invoked `gh workflow run` from the workspace root without `-R`, so GitHub CLI attempted repository inference from a directory with no .git.
exact_fix: Pass `-R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"` to `gh workflow run run-supervisor.yml` and require that invariant in the rehearsal verifier.
